title: PowerBI - 58 Devices Labor Burn Dashboard
blurb: End-to-end labor utilization dashboard built on a realistic A/E firm FP&A workflow — from Vantagepoint exports through Excel reconciliation to Power BI.
label: DASHBOARD
detail: A Power BI dashboard reconciling planned vs. actual labor hours across a 58-device MTA elevator and escalator replacement project. Integrates weekly labor projections, daily Vantagepoint timesheet exports, and subconsultant timesheets through an Excel + Power Query reconciliation layer, with DAX measures handling weekly-to-daily grain conversion and report supersession. Built with anonymized data; preserves real firm names and project context.

title: Prompt Engineering - Change Order Entitlement Analysis
blurb: SQL + Python pipeline reconciling PCO logs against Procore commitments across 14 active projects.
label: AI
detail: ETL pipeline that pulls daily snapshots from Procore, normalises change-order numbering across legacy and active projects, and flags PCOs missing back-up or stuck in approval >14 days. Surfaced $4.2M in unbilled approved changes in the first month.

title: Primavera P6 - Sample Schedule Built from RFP Documents
blurb: Preliminary schedule built to learn the mechanical skills of using Primavera P6.
label: SCHEDULE
detail: A Primavera P6 schedule built from the Project Requirements and Design Criteria for a design-build transit projects performing ADA upgrades at 2 stations.

title: Projectify
blurb: Rough order of magnitude estimate single page web application for Office Fit-outs
label: WEB DEVELOPMENT
detail: A data visualization tool built to help commercial building owners and prospective tenants forecast tenant fit-out costs at the concept stage, before design documents are available. Users input square footage and select a construction type to generate rough-order-of-magnitude (ROM) projections driven by $/SF benchmarks compiled from completed medical office fit-outs. Results render on an interactive D3.js bar chart that allows real-time scope adjustment, giving stakeholders immediate visibility into cost drivers and value engineering opportunities. The tool reflects core project controls principles — historical benchmarking, parametric estimating, and visual reporting — applied to early-stage feasibility decisions where cost certainty is lowest and the impact of scope choices is highest..
